rows.reasoning: Holdman voted Yea on the concurrence roll call for SB 1(ss) (2022 First Special Session), a single-subject abortion bill whose operative section makes abortion "a criminal act, except when performed under the following circumstances:" — where the abortion is necessary "to prevent any serious health risk to the pregnant woman or to save the pregnant woman's life", where the fetus has a lethal fetal anomaly, or where "the pregnancy is a result of rape or incest". That matches the rung that would "ban abortion except in cases of rape, incest, or a serious risk to the mother's life." The text excludes the rung that would "allow abortion during the first trimester, and after that only to protect the mother's health" (elective first-trimester abortion is criminalized) and the rung that would "ban abortion in all cases, with no exceptions."
